description: Na₄Co₇(PO₄)₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.72 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-83°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. There are four inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.27 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.21 Å. In the third Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 72-76°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.06 Å. In the fourth Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra and corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-62°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.10 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.60 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.59 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Co and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Co, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Co and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Co and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Co and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Co, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Co, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaCo₂P tetrahedra. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Co, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaCo₂P tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Co, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONaCo₂P trigonal pyramids.
